semantic_boundary: real Megatron rank-local backward from saved forward state and grad_output to local logits gradient
timer_sequence: real forward and ctx.saved_tensors construction outside timing
clone saved-state templates and preallocate output outside timing
event completion synchronization outside measured interval
included_stages: creation of arange_1d by exact Megatron prepare helper
creation of softmax_update by exact Megatron prepare helper
local CUDA launches and implementation-internal temporaries
allocation_policy: softmax/target_mask/masked_target/grad_output/output storage are allocated or cloned outside timing; exact helper-created arange_1d and softmax_update allocations remain inside timing
saved_state_policy: templates are cloned from real ctx.saved_tensors; identical inputs are used by future reference and candidate implementations
backward_policy: the exact no-label-smoothing Megatron helper path is the reference baseline; candidate must use one shared orchestration

collective_structure.outside_timed_range: forward has 1 MAX + 2 SUM; no backward collective

synchronization_policy: barriers coordinate ranks only before/after the event interval; CUDA events are recorded and queried on the current stream; no barrier or NCCL call is inside the event interval
rank_aggregation_policy: report rank-local distributions separately; per-config critical-path proxy for future training decisions is max(mean rank0, mean rank1), explicitly not a measured synchronization cost
measurement_policy: 3 independent invocations; each has 3 blocks of 10 measurements per rank/config; raw rows preserved
future_candidate_rule: reference and candidate must use identical orchestration, allocation, saved-state, stream and timing policy; only local implementation may differ
